name: Alnera Aluminium Co., Ltd.
summary: Alnera Aluminium Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of aluminum alloy parts for new energy vehicle battery systems in China. The company offers battery aluminum casing, structural components, casting rods, forged products, liquid-cooled integrated battery box housing, third-generation battery box housing, second-generation aluminum alloy battery box housing, and first-generation all-aluminum alloy profile battery box body; light truck van body, engineering dump truck body, stake car, and aluminum alloy carriage.
